description:
Stunning 3, 4 and 5 bedroom houses available to rent in Scholarstown, one of Dublin’s most fashionable suburbs.
 
Surrounded by beautiful landscapes, with great transport connections and plenty of local amenities, Occu Scholarstown residents will be able to find the ideal balance between the great outdoors and practical city living.
 
From award-winning architects, these fully furnished houses have been built using the latest technologies and innovative building methods. Open-plan layouts with outstanding finishes and plenty of natural light give a sense of restful calm. Built with our residents in mind, we’ve included the little touches that make life easier. 

Standard features of Occu Scholarstown Houses include the following:
- Contemporary, stylish, fully furnished interiors 
- Private garden
- Pet friendly
- Excellent energy efficiency 

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). 
Better Renting. That's different. 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3 
Please note, photos may not be specific to each available houses, but all houses are finished to similar standard.
